column1: # p374 — THE OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST OF p373's HYPOTHESIS.  Measured 2026-10-22, one tool (WebSearch).
# p373's hypothesis, as committed: "the necessity of an in-language leg is NOT a property of the
# query and NOT a property of the region.  It is a property of THE JURISDICTION'S OWN PUBLICATION
# CORPUS."  p373 derived it from Germany (no English corpus -> German necessary) and Brazil
# (English legal press -> English sufficient).  Both are jurisdictions p373 and its four
# predecessors had ALREADY sampled.
# 🟢 WHY THIS IS THE STRONGER HALF.  ACTION p373-D asked only for a RE-RUN of the same four
# cells.  A re-run cannot refute the hypothesis -- it can only add draws to the cells that
# generated it.  A hypothesis about jurisdictions is tested on a jurisdiction it has never seen.
# APAC was never touched by the crossed design at all, so both new cells are APAC.
# 🔴 PRE-REGISTERED, IN WRITING, BEFORE EITHER SEARCH RAN (scratchpad/p374/predictions.txt):
#   O5 Japan -- corpus-language call: JAPANESE.  MEXT publishes in Japanese; no routine
#               English-language education-policy press.  -> PREDICT NIL on the English leg.
#   O6 India -- corpus-language call: ENGLISH.  The ministry publishes IN English.
#               -> PREDICT PRODUCTIVE on the English leg.
#   REFUTATION CONDITION, stated in advance: "O5 productive, or O6 nil.  Either one breaks the
#   corpus-language account, because both are English legs naming country AND organ -- the exact
#   cell shape that split Germany from Brazil."

column1: # 🔴 THE PRE-REGISTERED REFUTATION CONDITION FIRED.  O5 is PRODUCTIVE.  p373's corpus-language
# account is REFUTED out of sample, by the exact cell shape that generated it, on a prediction
# written down before the measurement.
# 🟢 WHAT SURVIVES, AND IT FITS ALL SIX CELLS ACROSS FOUR JURISDICTIONS.  An English leg is
# productive wherever the jurisdiction's education policy is covered by a CROSS-BORDER
# SPECIALIST PRESS CHANNEL that publishes in English -- law firms and sector associations for
# Brazil (Mattos Filho, ABMES), regulatory trade press and news wires for Japan (MLex, Kyodo
# English), domestic English-language press for India.  It is NOT about the language the
# JURISDICTION publishes in.  It is about whether a TRADE CHANNEL covers that jurisdiction in
# the language of the query.  Germany is the one sampled jurisdiction where that channel is
# thin -- and R2 found even there a FRENCH aggregator carrying the KMK decision.
# 🟢 AND THE PART A STUDIO SHOULD ACT ON, which neither Gap 476 nor p373 reached: O5 and O5b are
# BOTH productive and they do NOT return the same facts.  The English leg returned POLICY
# MILESTONES (who referred what to which council, due when).  The Japanese leg returned
# OPERATIONAL DETAIL the English leg never mentioned -- the pilot-school count going 66 -> 281.
# 🔴 So the two legs are NOT substitutes and "is an in-language leg necessary?" was the wrong
# question for 168 passes.  Run both; they answer different questions.
# 🔴 STATED LIMITATION.  n=1 per new cell.  O5's refutation of p373 is a REFUTATION (one
# productive draw is sufficient to break a claim of necessity) but O6's confirmation is NOT
# an estimate.  The corpus-language COLUMN in regional-leg-register is therefore published as
